```xml
<Shell xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
       xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
       xmlns:views="clr-namespace:Shop.Views"
       x:Class="Shop.AppShell"
       FlyoutBehavior="Flyout">

    <FlyoutItem Title="Dashboard" Route="dashboard">
        <ShellContent Title="Dashboard"
                      Route="dashboardhome"
                      ContentTemplate="{DataTemplate views:DashboardPage}" />
    </FlyoutItem>

    <FlyoutItem Title="Products" Route="products">
        <Tab Title="Products" Route="producttabs">
            <ShellContent Title="Active"
                          Route="active"
                          ContentTemplate="{DataTemplate views:ActiveProductsPage}" />
            <ShellContent Title="Archived"
                          Route="archived"
                          ContentTemplate="{DataTemplate views:ArchivedProductsPage}" />
        </Tab>
    </FlyoutItem>

    <FlyoutItem Title="Settings" Route="settings">
        <ShellContent Title="Settings"
                      Route="settingshome"
                      ContentTemplate="{DataTemplate views:SettingsPage}" />
    </FlyoutItem>
</Shell>
```

Multiple `ShellContent` children in the Products `Tab` produce the requested Active and Archived top tabs. Every hierarchy element used for navigation has a stable route, and `ContentTemplate` keeps page creation lazy.

```csharp
public AppShell()
{
    InitializeComponent();
    Routing.RegisterRoute("productdetails", typeof(ProductDetailsPage));
}
```

`ProductDetailsPage` is outside the visual hierarchy, so it needs the explicit route registration.
